concept.concept: Bold typography: 'Principal. Teacher. Lunch Lady. Mom.' stacked in varsity-style lettering
concept.audience: Homeschooling mothers entering the fall academic year
concept.rationale: Homeschool community is tight-knit and identity-driven. Back-to-school timing is perfect. Multi-role humor resonates deeply and drives gifting and self-purchase.

design.image_prompt:
The design prominently features the text "PRINCIPAL
TEACHER
LUNCH LADY
MOM" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration, bold simple shapes, clean sharp edges, high contrast, screen-print aesthetic. Centered composition on plain solid background with generous margin. Limited palette: cream, deep navy, burnt orange, forest green. Solid color blocks, no gradients, no airbrush shading, no photorealism. Typography-driven design featuring four stacked words in heavy varsity block lettering, each word on its own line, slightly offset horizontally for dynamic rhythm. Bold retro serif block letters, all caps. No illustration elements, pure typography composition. Readable at 12x16 inches from across a room.
design.style: flat vector illustration, bold varsity typography, screen-print aesthetic, limited solid color palette, high contrast, no gradients or shading

verdict.reason: The phrase 'Principal. Teacher. Lunch Lady. Mom.' is a generic, descriptive list of common occupational and familial roles with no association to any known trademark, brand, celebrity, character, or protected slogan. No IP concerns identified.

image_verdict.reason: The design displays exactly the required text 'PRINCIPAL / TEACHER / LUNCH LADY / MOM' in the correct order, correctly spelled, with no additional or missing words. The typography is clean collegiate/varsity style with good color contrast (dark navy, orange, green) on a cream background. No IP risks, no anatomical elements, no artifacts, and no mockup present.

listing.title: Homeschool Mom T-Shirt 'Principal Teacher Lunch Lady Mom'
listing.description: A funny, relatable tee for homeschooling moms juggling multiple roles. Bold varsity-style lettering stacks the reality: Principal. Teacher. Lunch Lady. Mom. Soft, comfortable cotton perfect for the school year hustle. This shirt celebrates the multitasking mastery of homeschool parents who wear all the hats. Great for fall academic season photos, meeting other homeschool families, or just getting through Wednesday with humor intact. The classic design pairs with anything in your wardrobe. A gift that says 'I see you and your incredible work.'
